svg.title: Neelabja Mukhopadhyay
svg.desc: Neelabja Mukhopadhyay, student developer. I make machines that notice things. A tracked hand skeleton cycles through the five gestures of PresentoVision: open palm, fist, one finger, two fingers, three fingers.
